All six verified by eye. No product file was touched.

## Screenshots — `_dream_context/tmp/shots/shelf-r2/`

Dark theme, real `dist` server, real Chromium, scripted `claude` in a scratch HOME. Measured pane **1100×894px** (viewport 1320; the pane is what the app gives the chat surface at that width, not a value I could set directly).

| # | Path | Caption |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `1-rest.png` | Resting shelf — branch chip + four agent tags on one line, `:5173 ↗` as the accent link chip, no row, **no fold chip anywhere**. |
| 2 | `2-wrap.png` | 29 tags wrapping to **3 lines**, every one visible, composer unmoved — the deleted fold's replacement behaviour. |
| 3 | `3-progress-row.png` | Progress row open above the tag line: `64% · 7/11 · now: loopback url exception`, with the accent track filled — all read from the fixture task file through the real route. |
| 4 | `4-progress-popover.png` | The progress popover open — floating `role=dialog` above the shelf with `Run progress · 7/11 · 64%` in its header, the row beneath it unmoved. |
| 5 | `5-longpin-open.png` | A long pin expanded **in place** (M2b unchanged) — the clamped lede with its `…` chip on the top row, detail scrolling inside its 40%-of-pane cap. |
| 6 | `6-tray.png` | Background Commands tray — **3 genuinely live rows** (`running 0:01`, Stop each) above the shelf and composer, all three surfaces in one frame. |

Script (throwaway, not a gate, not a product file): `_dream_context/tmp/capture-shelf-shots.mjs`.

## Notes

**The tray is real, not faked.** The stand-in emits the documented frame order per shell — Bash `tool_use` first (that is where the reducer recovers each row's command), then `system:task_started` with the same `tool_use_id` and `task_type:'local_bash'`, then the `background_tasks_changed` roster — and never sends a terminal frame, so all three stay `running` with live clocks. No DOM was injected.

**Two things I got wrong on the first pass and corrected:**
- The fixed 450px crop decapitated shot 5 — the detail filled the frame and the lede row carrying the `…` chip sat above the cut, so the picture didn't show what its caption claimed. The crop now extends upward to include the whole shelf (and, for shot 6, the tray).
- My first tray row count said **19**; that came from a loose `[class*="row"]` fallback selector matching unrelated descendants. The real selector (`.chat-bgshells-row`) reports **3**, which is what the picture shows. Corrected before reporting.

**Nothing was left uncaptured** — all six states rendered from real session state.

**Unrelated, flagging as asked:** sleep debt is at **48/60** and the SessionStart hook is now recommending consolidation. Say the word and I'll run the sleep flow.
